<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Goblin Archer — Death Animation v1</title>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box} body{margin:0;background:#141722;color:#e8e2d5;font:15px system-ui} header{padding:18px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid #414756} h1{margin:0 0 6px;color:#d6b577;font-family:Georgia,serif} main{display:grid;grid-template-columns:360px 1fr;gap:16px;padding:16px} section,aside{background:#202531;border:1px solid #414756;border-radius:12px;padding:16px} .panel{display:grid;gap:10px} label{display:block;font-size:14px;color:#d8dce4} label span{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:4px} input[type=range]{width:100%} button,select,input[type=checkbox]{font:inherit} button,select{background:#303747;color:#f5f5f5;border:1px solid #626b7b;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px} button{cursor:pointer} .toolbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center} canvas{width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:12px;background:#10131a;border:1px solid #3f4654} textarea{width:100%;min-height:86px;background:#141722;color:#e8e2d5;border:1px solid #414756;border-radius:8px;padding:10px} small,p{color:#b8c0ce} .chip{display:inline-block;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:#2c3343;border:1px solid #4f596e;color:#d6b577} @media(max-width:980px){main{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header>
  <h1>Goblin Archer — Death Animation v1</h1>
  <small>Standalone death lab · matching the Goblin Raider finish, with separate bow drop, separate arrow fall, body breakup, and black cloud + skull.</small>
</header>
<main>
  <aside>
    <div class="panel">
      <div class="toolbar">
        <button id="play">Play death</button>
        <button id="reset">Reset</button>
        <span class="chip" id="state">Ready</span>
      </div>
      <label><span>Total duration <output id="durationOut"></output></span><input id="duration" type="range" min="1000" max="2600" step="50" value="1700"></label>
      <label><span>Fatal recoil <output id="recoilOut"></output></span><input id="recoil" type="range" min="0" max="40" step="1" value="18"></label>
      <label><span>Bow drop speed <output id="bowFallOut"></output></span><input id="bowFall" type="range" min="40" max="220" step="5" value="125"></label>
      <label><span>Bow spin <output id="bowSpinOut"></output></span><input id="bowSpin" type="range" min="30" max="420" step="5" value="210"></label>
      <label><span>Arrow fall speed <output id="arrowFallOut"></output></span><input id="arrowFall" type="range" min="30" max="240" step="5" value="145"></label>
      <label><span>Arrow spin <output id="arrowSpinOut"></output></span><input id="arrowSpin" type="range" min="0" max="720" step="10" value="280"></label>
      <label><span>Body breakup force <output id="burstOut"></output></span><input id="burst" type="range" min="20" max="180" step="5" value="95"></label>
      <label><span>Body fragment gravity <output id="gravityOut"></output></span><input id="gravity" type="range" min="40" max="220" step="5" value="120"></label>
      <label><span>Smoke size <output id="smokeScaleOut"></output></span><input id="smokeScale" type="range" min="40" max="180" step="5" value="105"></label>
      <label><span>Smoke linger <output id="smokeLingerOut"></output></span><input id="smokeLinger" type="range" min="200" max="1100" step="25" value="520"></label>
      <label><span>Skull rise <output id="skullRiseOut"></output></span><input id="skullRise" type="range" min="8" max="70" step="2" value="32"></label>
      <label><span>Skull brightness <output id="skullGlowOut"></output></span><input id="skullGlow" type="range" min="20" max="100" step="5" value="80"></label>
      <label><span>Scale reference</span><span><input id="showIronbound" type="checkbox" checked> Show Ironbound target</span></label>
      <label><span>Ground ring</span><span><input id="showRing" type="checkbox" checked> Show selection circle</span></label>
      <textarea id="notes">Approved direction:
- Bow drops separately.
- Arrow falls separately.
- Goblin Archer falls into pieces.
- Finishes with same black smoke + skull feel as the Goblin Raider death.
</textarea>
      <small>Tip: use this lab to approve timing and breakup feel before I wire the final death into the live game.</small>
    </div>
  </aside>
  <section>
    <canvas id="c" width="920" height="588"></canvas>
    <p>Sequence: fatal recoil → separate bow and arrow drop → body breakup → black smoke cloud → rising skull.</p>
  </section>
</main>
<script>
const sources = {"bg": "data:image/png;base64,
